messages:
maya: Quick sync 1 min We should shrink the pin/rollout manifest. Runtime only needs a tiny core + annotations. Thoughts?
lucas: Agree in principle. Need to ensure hard vs soft affinity and fallback are explicit.
sophia: Proposal: core = {schema_version, phase, affinity, priority, compatibility_hints, fallback_variant}. Annotations = string->string map.
kai: Sketch: schema_version="1", phase=canary|stable|deprecated, affinity=hard|soft|none, priority 0-100. Runtime ignores unknown annotation keys.
jamie: Ops: migrate existing manifests slowly. Validator should be permissive for one release, then strict. Also cap annotations (~4KB).
deploy-bot: system: validator v0.9 will start accepting schema_version in permissive mode for tenant alpha.
lucas: Action: Ill write validator rules + migration playbook.
kai: Ill update runtime reader (default affinity=none, honor fallback_variant).
sophia: Console docs: show core fields prominently; annotations collapsed. Recommend reserved prefixes (rdw:).
maya: Agreed. I'll post a short RFC with example manifest and migration timeline. Canaries next week. :thumbsup:
